gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-armata: Armata reads spacious, with generous gaps between every character. Snowburst One cuts its heading letters like a stencil sheet with wide bridges, so give the sans body a slightly larger size to stand up beside it.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet of wide bridges and bold swagger. Atkinson Hyperlegible follows with clipped capitals and ascenders beside its lowercase, and wide-set terminals on the s, a sober counterweight to the loud top.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-blinker: Snowburst One cuts a stencil sheet of letters joined by wide bridges. Blinker runs smooth as drawn wire, with open apertures and lines that hold their thickness, so a whole paragraph slides along easily.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-carrois-gothic-s: Carrois Gothic SC keeps a clear opening at the end of every curve, and its capitals and lowercase sit close in height. Beneath Snowburst One, the sans-serif text reads smoothly through a full paragraph.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-chivo: Snowburst One brings stencil bridges and a loud, bold voice to the heading. Chivo then settles in below as a sans-serif with lowercase packed up toward the caps and visible daylight through every curve.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-cossette-texte: Stencil punch up top: Snowburst One cuts wide bridges between its letters, while Cossette Texte gives its lowercase e a wide-eyed look. Loud meets quiet, and the strokes stay full to the ends.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-duru-sans: Modern in manner, Duru Sans gives small letters wide openings, so the bodies dominate the line while ascenders hardly show. Beneath Snowburst One, the plain sans text flows smoothly down the page.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-fresca: Cut-out and clean: Snowburst One brings stencil bridges, while Fresca keeps single-weight strokes with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Its open, connected counters let a long paragraph flow without snagging.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-gafata: Contemporary in feel, Gafata packs a deep band of lowercase beneath short ascenders, each e wide-eyed. And Snowburst One earns attention with stencil bridges, while Gafata does the quiet work of carrying the words.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-geist: Clean and level, Geist holds a quiet beat with no accents of weight, so words read as solid blocks. Snowburst One earns its keep big and brief, with stencil bridges.
